scope: Focused foreground input in the published v7 x64 catalog OTP fixture
method: Foreground pointer and keyboard input through Computer Use; visible catalog state and native accessibility tree inspected after each action
observations: Clicking the accepted example's fourth slot and pressing 7 changed its caller-owned status from 482 to 4827 and moved the caret to the fifth slot.
Backspace in the empty fifth slot restored the caller-owned status to 482 and moved the caret to the fourth slot.
Clicking the rejecting example's fourth slot and pressing 9 left its six visible slots at 482 with the fourth slot empty.

Copying fictional 73a9 from the catalog search with Ctrl+C, then pasting with Ctrl+V into the accepted example's first slot, replaced the whole value with 739; the letter was filtered and the caret moved to the fourth slot.
Left Arrow from the fourth slot selected the third slot's 9 without changing 739.
Clicking the secure example's fourth slot and pressing 5 added a fourth masked bullet and moved the caret to the fifth slot.
